attchmntText: Noida Toll Bridge Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Media Release'.
voiceSummary: Noida Toll Bridge Company Limited reported audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2FY27 increased by 9.79 percent to 12.90 crore, with Profit After Tax rising to 4.32 crore. Half-year consolidated revenue reached 25.70 crore, up 12.52 percent, while Profit After Tax stood at 9.65 crore. The company completed the second phase of carriageway upgradation and initiated a five-year preventive maintenance program. An independent technical assessment found no major structural strengthening required for the DND Flyway. The Delhi High Court granted an interim stay on the NOIDA Authority’s demand for over 100 crore in alleged advertisement license fees, extending protection until December 14, 2026. NTBCL shared 0.85 crore with the Noida Authority from advertising revenue during the quarter.

attchmntText: Noida Toll Bridge Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Audited financial results for the qurter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Noida Toll Bridge Company Limited approved standalone and consolidated audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 12, 2026. Independent auditors issued unmodified opinions on the results. The auditor's report includes an emphasis of matter regarding an NCLAT order dated March 12, 2020, concerning IL&FS. The company has not made provisions for interest on loans from ICICI Bank Limited and IL&FS Transportation Networks Limited aggregating Rs. 308.54 lakhs and Rs. 608.67 lakhs respectively for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The trading window for directors and insiders will open on Friday, November 14, 2025.
